acceptanceBasis: User accepted the locally authored turtle preview and requested the same level for the remaining forms.

modeling.seaTurtle: Three growth forms use the authored domed carapace, head, plastron and independently flexing closed flippers.
modeling.otherForms: 81 source-specific single-image reconstructions. Anatomical body-volume priors, thin fin membranes, closed mesh boundaries, original-photo UV textures and 11-bone body/fin rigs. Not photogrammetric scans.

visualReview.allForms: Original, side and oblique contact sheets inspected; four view renders and 12-frame cycles generated for each form.
visualReview.runtime: 20 representative forms in actual WebGL; console errors none; 390px layout no horizontal overflow; fish selection, floor placement, edit pause, 20-to-10 texture release and close/reopen verified.

limitations: Unseen body surfaces are inferred from one reference image, not independently photographed or artist-sculpted anatomical scans.
Thin fin filaments have finite mesh resolution; exact front/back texture anatomy is approximate.
Mobile layout was tested in a 390px browser viewport, not on every physical iOS/Android device.
